Core revision: 891f5776dbdf3cbf40919e27aa8d6e77a5f66c97
FighterMcHurtCtrl.as:662-711,116-125,172-179

Pure module: game/bvn_hurt_break.gd
Independent source examples: tests/bvn_hurt_break.gd (47/47 checks)
Report: work/bvn-hurt-break-test.json
No character image, effect image, actor or battle integration was modified.

Scope: renderHurtBreak is reached from ordinary action.isHurting/renderHurt.
FighterMcCtrler.render returns earlier for isHurtFlying and calls renderHurtFlying,
whose source logic exposes hurtDownJump, not renderHurtBreak. Do not broaden
this source hurt-break into every launch/down state without labelling an adapter.

Gate: special input, alive, energy>=50 WITHOUT the allowOverflow fallback,
Qi>=100, latest hurt HitVO.isBisha false, no isBreakDef in the whole accumulated
hurt history, and currentHurtDamage<=210. currentHurtDamage sums per-hit integer
getDamage() values, before target armour/defense reductions.
An existing energyOverLoad flag does NOT veto hasEnergy(50) when energy>=50.

Spend: useQi(100), then useEnergy(100). useEnergy sets cooldown24 animation
frames(.8s*30), clamps negative energy to0 and sets overload only when negative.
At E50..99 this deliberately exhausts/overloads; at E100 exactly0 does not
newly set overload. Existing overload is preserved. No arbitrary resource gate,
round cap, combo damage scaling, projectile removal or invulnerability duration
was added.

Resource selection: the original five meme fighters explicitly use comicType0,
selecting the original energyExplode branch. comicType1 uses original replaceSkill
(Naruto substitution), which is outside this module's supported art branch and
is returned as requires_replace_skill without spending. It is not silently
pretended to be the same ability.

energyExplode creates a NEW HitVO (owner=null,id=null), then assigns:
  currentArea=getCurrentRect(Rect(-100,-200,200,210)) AT CAST TIME
  power50, hitx15*direct, hitType5, hurtType1
  all other defaults retained: hity0, hurtTime300, targetApplyGtrue, checkDirecttrue
The captured area remains fixed while the actor later moves; do not tie it to
per-frame actor position. Stage unit1.6 maps it to320x336 worldpx. This blast
uses stage geometry, unlike the authored normal-body-height geometry adapter.

Important owner-null semantics: original hitx is already signed, and the HitVO
has no owner. Source doHurtAnimate multiplies by owner.direct ONLY if owner
exists. current_hit therefore supplies has_owner=false to the existing pure
HitRules reader, avoiding a second facing multiplication. Source signed -15
left-facing yields velocity(-15,0), not(+15,0). hity0 is not given the grounded
negative-hity extra impulse; it remains a horizontal flying/down reaction.

Owner-null does NOT suppress attacker Qi. GameMainLogicCtrl.as:383-396 snapshots
both directions, then calls B.beHit(...) and A.hit(...) for the first contact,
and A.beHit(...) and B.hit(...) for the opposite one. It does not branch on the
HitVO owner. FighterMain.as:258-280 gives a FighterMain attacker normal-hit Qi
for this id-null, power50 blast:50*.17=8.5 per successful fighter contact. The
existing hit-gap/contact reader determines repeat contacts. This is separate
from the owner's influence on knockback/direct; do not multiply signed hitx twice.

Exact counters and render ordering:
  begin hit10,steel60, allowBeHitfalse, supersteeltrue.
  first animation frame -> hit9,steel59, no blast hit.
  second -> hit8: call actual idle(), then overwrite allowBeHitfalse.
  source idle from hurt sets justHurtResume=true.
  third controller prelude restores allowBeHittrue, clears justHurtResume,
    then hit7: blast becomes active.
  strict getCurrentHits condition: VO exists and hitFrame<8.
  hit7..1 = seven active animation frames. At0, VO clears and allowBeHittrue.
  each steel tick reasserts steel+supersteel AFTER idle's steel reset.
  steel reaches0 exactly at60th frame and clears. It is not permanent.
The source does NOT make all10 hit frames invulnerable; supersteel is distinct
from allowBeHit=false. Apply final helper steel/allow fields AFTER processing the
idle event, or actor idle will incorrectly overwrite them.

Idle movement is branch-sensitive: FighterMcCtrler.as:200-212 sets both velocity
axes0 and restores jump/air-attack budgets on the grounded idle branch. In air it
calls FighterMcAirHandler.fall():233-260. That leaves vertical velocity and damping
intact; on the first fall entry it sets X velocity0. If already falling/doing an
action, fall returns early. Do not apply grounded zero-velocity behavior in air
or describe preserving both axes unconditionally as the exact source behavior.

APIs:
  eligibility(source)->{allowed,reason,raw_hurt_damage,...}
  can(source)->bool
  begin(source,world_position,facing,stage_unit=1.6)->{allowed,state,events,...}
  render_frame(state)->next   # one exact30Hz animation frame
  tick(state,delta_seconds)->next  # accumulator adapter for60Hz/variable callers
  current_hit(state)->source HitVO with currentArea plus existing snake-case aliases
  raw_hurt_damage(hurt_hits)->int
Caller state may supply explicit last_bisha/hurt_break_hit/current_hurt_damage or
raw hurt_hits/last_hit. It supplies alive, hurting(or source action_state21/hurt),
special_pressed, energy, qi and optional comic_type0/energy_overload flags.
Caller performs actual idle transition, clears actor hurt history on idle_event,
keeps movement/graphics separate, and regenerates resources in the existing
resource module. This helper intentionally does not tick resource recovery twice.
